title: Old man Petit and offers to teach him music
summary: Old man Petit played with him, and Joe Nichols and a WPA band director each offered him lessons.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Is he a relative of Buddy Petit, says Buddy?

It is a Petit, that's it. Old man Petit. I think it's the old man, it's Buddy's brother or his daddy, one of the two. Now when I tell guys I played with him, they say, man you're older than you are. But the old man was gone during that time, he was just hanging on, you know. Well all the fellas was older than me when I played with that particular band. They're always old men, I was a young fella, a young boy. When I played with, played them two Jo with those two particular fellas like I tell them. That's the man Buddy, old man Petit. Petit.

I asked the man who wanted to teach me music, Joe Nichols. He liked my playing so much. He said, come now and I'll show you and I'll learn you a lot about it. Him, he made the offer to me and another guy made an offer to me. He stayed to Old Falls to play a crowd. Connick. He saw, he had charge of this, what you call this band they had up around here, the welfare, was it?
Oh I know what you're talking about, when they had the WPA band.

Yeah, he had charge of the WPA band. He made an offer to me too, he wanted to teach me music. Where did he live? He lived uptown, I know the man, I just can't call his name. I know who you're talking about. Cause he was in Kid Howard's Brass Band too. I don't know.
